title: Thai Grilled Skewers with Hummus
description: A tasty and refreshing Thai-inspired dish featuring grilled skewers paired with a creamy hummus sauce.

ingredients.name: grassy
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens such as Thai basil or cilantro

instructions: 2. Thread grassy, kissed, and korean ingredients onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. Brush the skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender.
5. Meanwhile, mix hummus with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of cilantro.
6. Serve the grilled skewers with hummus sauce for dipping.
